scope: Read-only source qualification, not an embedding experiment or application initial check
runtime: Existing bundled Python3.12.14 and NumPy2.3.5;temporary unmodified h5py3.14.0 cp312 arm64 wheel with HDF5 1.14.6
observed_before_registration: Prior numeric profile and metadata-field names;read-only schema reveals categorical cardinalities/shapes,not decoded cell-level string values or label-conflict outcomes. Not blind discovery.
checks: Read every target field with UTF-8 strict decoding;compare h5py asstr with direct bytes decoding
For categorical columns check integer codes,range,missing -1,categories uniqueness and reconstruction;do not fill unknown strings
Check declared row/protein lengths,cell identifier uniqueness and normalized whitespace/case collisions without automatic merging
Record missing,empty/sentinel and category counts separately;metadata read failure is not source missingness
Independently reconstruct the small CSC matrix and reconcile row counts/features and protein totals with source metadata and prior profile
Compare exact duplicate feature groups with perturbation and guide labels;report ambiguous groups and empirical majority-label lower bound without deleting legitimate cells
Check guide-to-perturbation relation and nperts field;labels are experimental annotations,not independent phenotype or causal ground truth
Preserve fixed version and source hashes;no freshness/trend inference from one file
limits: No normalization,pseudobulk,geometry fitting,compression,map,all-pair distortion,neighbor score,forecast,clinical or causal test. Original APP09402 10% prediction unchanged and untested. Four-coordinate identity remains mandatory old baseline;finite common-law constructor remains independent gate.
output_policy: Aggregate profiles and necessary small category/group examples only;no full matrix/cell-barcode copy. Gzip all generated profiles/logs with verified decompression hashes;remove temporary source/wheel extraction after preserving version,hash and license references. No installation into existing runtimes.
